text:
Priority: normal
Record the check names main requires, and test that CI still produces them

On 2026-10-31 job 20261031-001537-0rz6 renamed the final CI job, and no landing could merge for about an hour: GitHub branch protection on main requires a status check named "fmt, clippy, tests", and that rule lives in GitHub's settings, which no agent can read. Nothing in the repository recorded it, so no test could catch the rename.

Add a small checked-in file listing the status check names that branch protection on main requires (today: "fmt, clippy, tests"), and an xtask test that fails when .github/workflows/ci.yml has no job whose name matches each listed check. Mention the file in the ci.yml header comment, so a person who changes the protection rule knows to update it.

Acceptance:
- A test reads the file and ci.yml and passes on the current files.
- The same test fails on a copy of ci.yml where the final job's name is changed.
- fmt, clippy with -D warnings and the test suite pass; CHANGELOG.md has an entry.
